ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  63 moons technologies limited has announced the incorporation of a new step-down subsidiary, 63 Digital Asset Technologies Private Limited, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Ticker Limited. This new entity aims to develop IT/ITeS solutions in emerging technologies for global enterprises, financial institutions, and governments, marking a strategic expansion into the digital sector. With a modest initial cash investment of Rs. 1.5 million, this represents a routine corporate development with no immediate material financial impacts or apparent red flags.
